status: frozen for this bounded baseline; experimental, not production

attributes.regular_use: Explicit ongoing regular use; never implies today's dose was taken.
attributes.home_preencounter: Explicit home or pre-encounter use; independent of regular use and never encounter administration.
attributes.encounter_administered: Actually administered during this encounter, not planned or patient-reported use alone.
attributes.planned: Planned action, not evidence it occurred.
attributes.not_administered: Explicitly not given/not yet given. Preserve exact medication versus broader treatment scope in the evidence/topic.
attributes.not_asked: Explicitly not asked; not unknown or negative.
attributes.unknown: Explicitly unknown or not remembered; not not-asked or negative.
attributes.not_documented: Explicit statement something was not recorded; do not label every absent detail this way.
attributes.explicit_absence: Explicit negative/absence, with original scope and attribution.
attributes.pending_result: Explicitly awaiting a result; planned test with no specimen is not pending.

semantics: Each fact has exact quoted evidence and optional context-unit links. Attributes apply only to that fact's evidence, not all context. Multiple facts can overlap one unit/S paragraph. No dose/route/time/frequency fields or generated clinical prose. These details remain exact source text; no rate calculation or unit conversion.
scope_policy: Only requested unit/topic scopes are targets. Full note remains context. Unrequested/partially reviewed positions are not negative targets. Empty facts is allowed.
old_contracts: Preserved; old A/B predictions cannot be reinterpreted under this contract.
oral_normalization: Optional display-only oral normalization for medication evidence containing exact уудаг/уусан with linked original quote; never changes evidence, agent, regularity or encounter status. Not a generated target.
